title: Closing Editor Settings dialog during editor update closes the main editor
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.6.dev.custom_build [0156b2bcd], v4.5.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev (0156b2bcd) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 24 Nov 2025 15:21:09 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 580.105.08) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F (16 threads) - 15.37 GiB memory

### Issue description

After updating some editor settings, the editor will freeze for a brief moment for update. This is expected.

But if you smash the window close button of the Editor Settings dialog during this period, after the editor finished updating, the editor is likely to be closed as well 😆 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/65409f2e-1467-46d7-a7da-021f805be0dd

### Steps to reproduce

1. In the main editor, open the Editor Settings dialog
2. Change some settings so that the editor will freeze for a brief moment for update (e.g., changing the theme)
3. During the period that the editor is frozen, smash the window close button of the editor settings dialog
4. After the editor update is finished, the main editor is also closed

N/A
